description: How many backups of the save files the program keeps (core/save/backup.py). The newest set and every pinned set are always kept, whatever these say. Each entry is {"value": ..., "description": ...}; edit the values by hand, the code reads them.

automatic_sets.description: How many sets the program's own snapshots keep (before an install, an update, a write to a save).

manual_sets.description: How many sets the player's own backups keep.

emulator_processes.description: Process names (lower case, without .exe) of the emulators: a save is not written while one runs.
